card.name: Quantity words before a limit or count
card.fires_on: Small words that set up an amount or limit, such as more, most, twice, too, or a space before a number like 65 or 360. They sit just before the quantity or comparison is completed.

modes.label: Amount words
modes.description: Words like more, most, twice, too or entirely that begin a quantity or limit phrase.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or the number itself just before a count or age figure in study results.
